# Kitchen Production Ticket - Expeditor Station
Order 142 - Dine In - Table 6 - Time: 12:44 PM

## Order Summary Table
| Item | Base Spec | Modifications | Station |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1x Double Smashburger | Two 3 oz beef patties, cheddar, pickles, sauce | Sub Swiss, NO pickles, ADD bacon | Grill |
| 1x Crispy Chicken Sandwich | Fried chicken breast, slaw, spicy mayo, brioche | NO spicy mayo, ADD sliced tomato | Fryer |
| 1x Large Seasoned Fries | 8 oz fries, house blend seasoning | Salt only, NO house blend | Fryer |
| 1x Grilled Chicken Wrap | 6 oz sliced chicken, romaine, ranch, wheat wrap | Sub ranch for vinaigrette, ADD cheddar | Flat top |

## Cooking and Assembly Instructions
- Drop two 3 oz patties on the grill, smash thin, sear for 90 seconds per side, and melt one slice of cheddar over the top.
- Toast a brioche bun, spread standard mayo on bottom heel, place fried breast, layer sliced tomato, and finish with slaw on top crown.
- Drop 8 oz french fries in dedicated fry vat at 350°F for 3 minutes until golden brown.
- Dump cooked fries into clean prep bowl, sprinkle with salt only, and toss thoroughly.
- Warm wheat tortilla on flat top for 10 seconds, assemble sliced grilled chicken breast with romaine lettuce, vinaigrette, and shredded cheddar.
- Because Table 6 requested no seasoning blend on the fries, double-season the patties with house rub before plating.

errors.explanation: The order summary specifies 'Sub Swiss' for the Double Smashburger, but the cooking instruction specifies melting cheddar instead.
errors.fix: melt one slice of Swiss over the top

errors.explanation: A customer requesting no seasoning on their fries does not logically lead to adding double seasoning rub to the burger patties, which directly contradicts proper prep standards and dietary preferences.
errors.fix: Season the patties with standard salt and pepper before plating.
